af.consent.title: Before you start
af.consent.lead: Here is what Tengo uses, why, and what you can change.
af.consent.notice.what.title: What we use
af.consent.notice.what.body: Transaction dates, amounts and descriptions, plus your current balance. Nothing else.
af.consent.notice.why.title: Why
af.consent.notice.why.body: To work out how long your money lasts and when your next money is likely. Not for marketing or credit scoring.
af.consent.notice.who.title: Who can see it
af.consent.notice.who.body: Anyone using this browser on this device. No one at Tengo can see it.
af.consent.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
af.consent.notice.where.body: In your browser, on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
af.consent.notice.how.title: How long we keep it
af.consent.notice.how.body: Records older than 12 months are removed from this device. You can delete everything any time.
af.consent.core.title: Forecast
af.consent.core.body: Needed to use Tengo. Withdraw any time and the forecast pauses.
af.consent.messages.title: Daily messages
af.consent.messages.body: A short daily update with your date, by WhatsApp or SMS. WhatsApp messages pass through Meta, outside South Africa. Off until you turn it on. Simulated, nothing is sent.
af.consent.analytics.title: Product analytics
af.consent.analytics.body: Helps improve Tengo. Off by default. No analytics runs in this demo.
af.consent.changeLater: You can change these any time in Privacy.
af.privacy.simulated: Simulated privacy controls. Not a compliance certification.

af.stateCard.title: Cover
af.stateCard.enough: Covered until your next money, even on a heavy week.
af.stateCard.tight: Covered on a normal week, not on a heavy one.
af.stateCard.short_one: Runs out {{count}} day before your next money.
af.stateCard.short_other: Runs out {{count}} days before your next money.
af.stateCard.tightReserve: Covered until your next money, but {{amount}} is needed for a bill soon after it.
af.stateCard.unclearThin: Tengo needs at least 14 days of money history to work out a date. Import a statement or add a few weeks of entries.
af.stateCard.unclearNoIncome: No money coming in was found in your history. Add your income, or set it up by hand, to get an answer.
af.stateCard.noIncomeRunway: With nothing coming in, your balance lasts until {{date}} at your usual spend.
af.stateCard.unclearStale: Your balance is more than two weeks old. Add today's balance to see your date.
af.stateCard.enoughHorizon: Lasts the next {{days}} days even on a heavy week, with no money expected.
af.stateCard.tightHorizon: Lasts the next {{days}} days on a normal week, not on a heavy one. No money is expected.
af.stateCard.shortHorizon: Runs out within the next {{days}} days, and no money is expected.
af.stateCard.enoughDaily: Lasts the next {{days}} days even on a heavy week, counting half of what usually comes in each day.
af.stateCard.tightDaily: Lasts the next {{days}} days on a normal week, counting half of what usually comes in each day. Not on a heavy one.
af.stateCard.shortDaily: Runs out within the next {{days}} days, even counting half of what usually comes in each day.

af.why.title: Why this date
af.why.plain: We start with your balance today, take off bills on their due dates, and spend at your usual daily rate until the money reaches zero. That day is your date. Money you have not received yet is not counted.
af.why.chartLabel: How the balance runs down on a normal, light and heavy week
af.why.dailySpendHint: Light to heavy week: {{low}} to {{high}} a day
af.why.confidenceHint.low: Under 28 days. The range is wider.
af.why.rule.enough: Even a heavy week lasts until the latest likely next money.
af.why.rule.tight: A normal week lasts until the usual next money. A heavy week does not.
af.why.rule.short: A normal week runs out before the usual next money.
af.why.rule.unclear: Not enough history or no income, so there is no date yet.
af.why.question: Question this result
af.why.notAdvice: This is an estimate from past patterns, not financial advice, and it is not used for any credit or lending decision.
af.why.budgetSpread: The daily budget is spread to {{date}}, the latest your next money usually lands.
af.why.reserve: Kept back for bills just after next money
af.why.reserveNone: None due in the week after
af.why.horizon: No money is expected, so the cover is judged over the next {{count}} days.
af.why.horizonDaily: Money comes in most days, so the cover is judged over the next {{count}} days, counting half of your usual daily income.

af.me.title: Me
af.me.persona: Who you are in the demo
af.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
af.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
af.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
af.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
af.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
af.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.
af.me.sim.data: All people and money are fictional composites.
af.me.sim.bank: There is no bank connection and no open banking.
af.me.sim.messages: Messages are previews. Nothing is sent.

af.me.sim.translations: English is the source. The other 10 languages are AI drafts that first-language speakers still need to check, so some wording may be wrong.

af.help.title: What helps most
af.help.moveBill: If {{name}} ({{amount}}) can be paid after {{date}} without a fee, that alone reaches {{state}}.
af.help.setAside: You could set aside up to {{amount}} today and still be Enough until your next money. This is the same room as Room to lend, not extra.
af.help.coveredBody: Your money should last until your next money, even on a heavier week.
af.help.earn: Earn or receive {{amount}} more before {{date}}, for example extra work or money owed to you.
af.help.earnAssume: Assumes your spending stays as usual. Borrowing to cover a gap usually costs more later.
af.help.trim: Spend about {{amount}} a day less on {{groups}} until {{date}}.
af.help.trimAssume: Only spending you marked as able to bend. Assumes everything else stays as usual.
af.help.trimPartial: That is all the spending you marked as able to bend, so it covers part of the gap. The rest still needs money in.
af.help.moveAssume: You marked it as movable. Ask first. Never skip debit orders for loans or insurance.
af.help.markFlexible: Mark which everyday spending can bend to see where you could trim.

af.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
af.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
af.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
af.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
af.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
af.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
af.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
af.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
af.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
af.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
af.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
af.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
af.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
af.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
af.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
af.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
af.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.

af.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
af.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
af.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
af.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
af.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
af.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
af.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
af.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
af.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
af.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
af.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
af.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
af.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
af.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
af.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
af.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
af.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
af.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
af.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
af.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
af.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
af.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
af.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
af.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
af.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
af.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
af.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
af.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
af.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
af.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
af.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
af.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

zu.me.title: Me
zu.me.persona: Who you are in the demo
zu.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
zu.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
zu.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
zu.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
zu.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
zu.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.
zu.me.sim.data: All people and money are fictional composites.
zu.me.sim.bank: There is no bank connection and no open banking.
zu.me.sim.messages: Messages are previews. Nothing is sent.

zu.me.sim.translations: English is the source. The other 10 languages are AI drafts that first-language speakers still need to check, so some wording may be wrong.

zu.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
zu.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
zu.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
zu.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
zu.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
zu.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
zu.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
zu.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
zu.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
zu.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
zu.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
zu.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
zu.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
zu.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
zu.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
zu.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
zu.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.

zu.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
zu.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
zu.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
zu.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
zu.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
zu.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
zu.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
zu.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
zu.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
zu.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
zu.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
zu.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
zu.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
zu.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
zu.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
zu.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
zu.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
zu.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
zu.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
zu.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
zu.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
zu.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
zu.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
zu.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
zu.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
zu.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
zu.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
zu.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
zu.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
zu.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
zu.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
zu.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

zu.landing.faq.title: Before you try it
zu.landing.faq.bank.a: No. Tengo is a pilot app that estimates how long your money lasts. It does not hold money, lend, sell products or give financial advice.
zu.landing.faq.data.a: As a guest, your data stays in this browser on your device and nothing is sent to Tengo. Anyone who uses this browser can open it, so use the PIN lock on a shared phone. An account is optional; it stores your data with the database provider named in the privacy notice.

zu.landing.faq.wrong.q: What if the date is wrong?
zu.landing.faq.wrong.a: It is an estimate from your own history, so it can be wrong. Open Why this date to see what went in, correct any transaction on Money, or use Question this result to ask for a check. In this demo that request is simulated and stays on your device.

xh.me.persona: Who you are in the demo
xh.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
xh.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
xh.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
xh.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
xh.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
xh.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.

xh.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
xh.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
xh.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
xh.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
xh.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
xh.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
xh.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
xh.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
xh.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
xh.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
xh.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
xh.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
xh.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
xh.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
xh.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
xh.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
xh.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.

xh.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
xh.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
xh.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
xh.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
xh.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
xh.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
xh.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
xh.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
xh.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
xh.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
xh.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
xh.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
xh.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
xh.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
xh.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
xh.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
xh.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
xh.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
xh.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
xh.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
xh.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
xh.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
xh.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
xh.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
xh.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
xh.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
xh.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
xh.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
xh.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
xh.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
xh.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
xh.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

nso.me.title: Me
nso.me.persona: Who you are in the demo
nso.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
nso.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
nso.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
nso.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
nso.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
nso.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.
nso.me.sim.data: All people and money are fictional composites.
nso.me.sim.bank: There is no bank connection and no open banking.
nso.me.sim.messages: Messages are previews. Nothing is sent.
nso.me.sim.privacy: Privacy controls show good practice. They are not a compliance certification.
nso.me.sim.translations: English is the source. The other 10 languages are AI drafts that first-language speakers still need to check, so some wording may be wrong.
nso.me.resetBody: Clears the fictional people, your own profile on this device, consent choices and logs, and starts fresh. An account, if you saved one, is not touched.

nso.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
nso.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
nso.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
nso.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
nso.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
nso.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
nso.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
nso.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
nso.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
nso.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
nso.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
nso.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
nso.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
nso.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
nso.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
nso.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
nso.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.

nso.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
nso.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
nso.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
nso.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
nso.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
nso.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
nso.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
nso.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
nso.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
nso.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
nso.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
nso.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
nso.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
nso.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
nso.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
nso.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
nso.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
nso.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
nso.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
nso.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
nso.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
nso.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
nso.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
nso.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
nso.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
nso.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
nso.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
nso.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
nso.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
nso.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
nso.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
nso.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

st.me.persona: Who you are in the demo
st.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
st.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
st.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
st.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
st.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
st.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.

st.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
st.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
st.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
st.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
st.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
st.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
st.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
st.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
st.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
st.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
st.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
st.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
st.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
st.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
st.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
st.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
st.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.

st.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
st.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
st.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
st.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
st.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
st.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
st.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
st.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
st.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
st.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
st.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
st.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
st.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
st.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
st.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
st.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
st.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
st.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
st.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
st.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
st.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
st.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
st.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
st.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
st.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
st.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
st.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
st.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
st.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
st.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
st.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
st.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

tn.me.title: Me
tn.me.persona: Who you are in the demo
tn.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
tn.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
tn.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
tn.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
tn.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
tn.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.

tn.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
tn.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
tn.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
tn.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
tn.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
tn.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
tn.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
tn.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
tn.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
tn.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
tn.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
tn.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does

tn.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
tn.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
tn.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
tn.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
tn.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
tn.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
tn.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
tn.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
tn.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
tn.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
tn.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
tn.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
tn.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
tn.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
tn.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
tn.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
tn.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
tn.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
tn.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
tn.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
tn.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
tn.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
tn.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
tn.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
tn.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
tn.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
tn.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
tn.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
tn.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
tn.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
tn.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
tn.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

ts.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
ts.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
ts.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
ts.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
ts.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
ts.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.

ts.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
ts.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
ts.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
ts.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
ts.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
ts.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
ts.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
ts.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
ts.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
ts.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
ts.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
ts.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
ts.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
ts.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
ts.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
ts.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
ts.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.

ts.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
ts.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
ts.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
ts.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
ts.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
ts.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
ts.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
ts.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
ts.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
ts.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
ts.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
ts.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
ts.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
ts.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
ts.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
ts.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
ts.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
ts.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
ts.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
ts.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
ts.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
ts.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
ts.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
ts.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
ts.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
ts.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
ts.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
ts.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
ts.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
ts.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
ts.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
ts.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

ts.landing.faq.title: Before you try it
ts.landing.faq.bank.a: No. Tengo is a pilot app that estimates how long your money lasts. It does not hold money, lend, sell products or give financial advice.
ts.landing.faq.data.a: As a guest, your data stays in this browser on your device and nothing is sent to Tengo. Anyone who uses this browser can open it, so use the PIN lock on a shared phone. An account is optional; it stores your data with the database provider named in the privacy notice.
ts.landing.faq.cost.a: Nothing. Tengo is free to use during the pilot, with no sign up needed.
ts.landing.faq.wrong.q: What if the date is wrong?
ts.landing.faq.wrong.a: It is an estimate from your own history, so it can be wrong. Open Why this date to see what went in, correct any transaction on Money, or use Question this result to ask for a check. In this demo that request is simulated and stays on your device.

ss.consent.title: Before you start
ss.consent.lead: Here is what Tengo uses, why, and what you can change.
ss.consent.notice.what.title: What we use
ss.consent.notice.what.body: Transaction dates, amounts and descriptions, plus your current balance. Nothing else.
ss.consent.notice.why.title: Why
ss.consent.notice.why.body: To work out how long your money lasts and when your next money is likely. Not for marketing or credit scoring.
ss.consent.notice.who.title: Who can see it
ss.consent.notice.who.body: Anyone using this browser on this device. No one at Tengo can see it.
ss.consent.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
ss.consent.notice.where.body: In your browser, on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
ss.consent.notice.how.title: How long we keep it
ss.consent.notice.how.body: Records older than 12 months are removed from this device. You can delete everything any time.
ss.consent.core.title: Forecast
ss.consent.core.body: Needed to use Tengo. Withdraw any time and the forecast pauses.
ss.consent.messages.title: Daily messages
ss.consent.messages.body: A short daily update with your date, by WhatsApp or SMS. WhatsApp messages pass through Meta, outside South Africa. Off until you turn it on. Simulated, nothing is sent.
ss.consent.analytics.title: Product analytics
ss.consent.analytics.body: Helps improve Tengo. Off by default. No analytics runs in this demo.

ss.stateCard.enough: Covered until your next money, even on a heavy week.
ss.stateCard.tight: Covered on a normal week, not on a heavy one.
ss.stateCard.short_one: Runs out {{count}} day before your next money.
ss.stateCard.short_other: Runs out {{count}} days before your next money.
ss.stateCard.tightReserve: Covered until your next money, but {{amount}} is needed for a bill soon after it.

ss.stateCard.noIncomeRunway: With nothing coming in, your balance lasts until {{date}} at your usual spend.

ss.stateCard.tightHorizon: Lasts the next {{days}} days on a normal week, not on a heavy one. No money is expected.

ss.stateCard.tightDaily: Lasts the next {{days}} days on a normal week, counting half of what usually comes in each day. Not on a heavy one.

ss.why.title: Why this date
ss.why.plain: We start with your balance today, take off bills on their due dates, and spend at your usual daily rate until the money reaches zero. That day is your date. Money you have not received yet is not counted.
ss.why.chartLabel: How the balance runs down on a normal, light and heavy week

ss.why.rule.enough: Even a heavy week lasts until the latest likely next money.
ss.why.rule.tight: A normal week lasts until the usual next money. A heavy week does not.
ss.why.rule.short: A normal week runs out before the usual next money.
ss.why.rule.unclear: Not enough history or no income, so there is no date yet.
ss.why.question: Question this result

ss.why.reserve: Kept back for bills just after next money
ss.why.reserveNone: None due in the week after
ss.why.horizon: No money is expected, so the cover is judged over the next {{count}} days.
ss.why.horizonDaily: Money comes in most days, so the cover is judged over the next {{count}} days, counting half of your usual daily income.

ss.me.title: Me
ss.me.persona: Who you are in the demo
ss.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
ss.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
ss.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
ss.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
ss.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
ss.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.
ss.me.sim.data: All people and money are fictional composites.
ss.me.sim.bank: There is no bank connection and no open banking.
ss.me.sim.messages: Messages are previews. Nothing is sent.

ss.me.sim.translations: English is the source. The other 10 languages are AI drafts that first-language speakers still need to check, so some wording may be wrong.

ss.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
ss.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
ss.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
ss.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
ss.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
ss.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
ss.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
ss.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
ss.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
ss.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
ss.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
ss.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
ss.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
ss.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
ss.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
ss.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
ss.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.

ss.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
ss.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
ss.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
ss.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
ss.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
ss.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
ss.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
ss.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
ss.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
ss.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
ss.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
ss.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
ss.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
ss.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
ss.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
ss.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
ss.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
ss.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
ss.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
ss.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
ss.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
ss.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
ss.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
ss.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
ss.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
ss.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
ss.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
ss.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
ss.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
ss.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
ss.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
ss.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

nr.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
nr.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
nr.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
nr.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
nr.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
nr.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.

nr.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
nr.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
nr.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
nr.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
nr.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
nr.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
nr.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
nr.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
nr.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
nr.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
nr.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
nr.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
nr.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
nr.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
nr.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
nr.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
nr.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.
