nr.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
nr.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
nr.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
nr.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
nr.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
nr.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
nr.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
nr.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
nr.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
nr.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
nr.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
nr.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
nr.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
nr.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
nr.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
nr.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
nr.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
nr.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
nr.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
nr.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
nr.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
nr.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
nr.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
nr.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
nr.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
nr.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
nr.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
nr.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
nr.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
nr.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
nr.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
nr.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

nr.landing.faq.title: Before you try it
nr.landing.faq.bank.a: No. Tengo is a pilot app that estimates how long your money lasts. It does not hold money, lend, sell products or give financial advice.
nr.landing.faq.data.a: As a guest, your data stays in this browser on your device and nothing is sent to Tengo. Anyone who uses this browser can open it, so use the PIN lock on a shared phone. An account is optional; it stores your data with the database provider named in the privacy notice.
nr.landing.faq.cost.a: Nothing. Tengo is free to use during the pilot, with no sign up needed.
nr.landing.faq.wrong.q: What if the date is wrong?
nr.landing.faq.wrong.a: It is an estimate from your own history, so it can be wrong. Open Why this date to see what went in, correct any transaction on Money, or use Question this result to ask for a check. In this demo that request is simulated and stays on your device.

ve.consent.lead: Here is what Tengo uses, why, and what you can change.

ve.consent.notice.what.body: Transaction dates, amounts and descriptions, plus your current balance. Nothing else.

ve.consent.notice.why.body: To work out how long your money lasts and when your next money is likely. Not for marketing or credit scoring.

ve.me.title: Me
ve.me.persona: Who you are in the demo
ve.me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.
ve.me.how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
ve.me.how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
ve.me.how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
ve.me.how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
ve.me.how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.

ve.notice.estimated.title: Estimated from your answers
ve.notice.estimated.body: Part of your history comes from the setup questions, so confidence is low. Real entries, cash added here or a statement replace the estimate.

ve.safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
ve.safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
ve.safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.
ve.safetyPolicy.adults.title: Adults only
ve.safetyPolicy.adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.
ve.safetyPolicy.shared.title: Shared phones
ve.safetyPolicy.shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave the money screens and go straight back to the profiles. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.
ve.safetyPolicy.control.title: If someone controls your money
ve.safetyPolicy.control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.
ve.safetyPolicy.care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
ve.safetyPolicy.care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.
ve.safetyPolicy.never.title: What Tengo never does
ve.safetyPolicy.never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.
ve.safetyPolicy.help.title: If you need help now
ve.safetyPolicy.help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
ve.safetyPolicy.help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.
ve.safetyPolicy.help.note: Numbers to be confirmed before launch. Tengo is not an emergency service.

ve.welcome.s1.lead: Tengo works out how long your money lasts and when your next money usually lands. It only needs a little to do that.
ve.welcome.s1.money.title: Your money in and out
ve.welcome.s1.money.body: Dates, amounts and short descriptions, and your balance. From a statement, from a few answers, or from sample numbers.
ve.welcome.s1.bills.title: Regular bills and money you owe
ve.welcome.s1.bills.body: Things like rent, a phone contract or a stokvel, so Tengo can keep money back for them.
ve.welcome.s1.never.title: Never
ve.welcome.s1.never.body: Tengo never asks for an ID number, a phone number, a bank login or a PIN.
ve.welcome.s1.where.title: Where it stays
ve.welcome.s1.where.body: On this device only, unless you later choose to save it to an account. You can delete it any time.

ve.welcome.s2.notice: The full privacy notice says what is kept, where, for how long, and how to complain.

ve.legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
ve.legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.
ve.legalDoc.notice.title: Privacy notice
ve.legalDoc.notice.what.title: What Tengo keeps
ve.legalDoc.notice.what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.
ve.legalDoc.notice.why.title: Why
ve.legalDoc.notice.why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.
ve.legalDoc.notice.where.title: Where it is processed
ve.legalDoc.notice.where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.
ve.legalDoc.notice.who.title: Who can see it
ve.legalDoc.notice.who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.
ve.legalDoc.notice.keep.title: How long it is kept
ve.legalDoc.notice.keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.
ve.legalDoc.notice.rights.title: Your rights
ve.legalDoc.notice.rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.
ve.legalDoc.notice.not.title: What Tengo is not
ve.legalDoc.notice.not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.
ve.legalDoc.notice.changes.title: Changes
ve.legalDoc.notice.changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.
ve.legalDoc.terms.title: Terms of use
ve.legalDoc.terms.use.title: Using Tengo
ve.legalDoc.terms.use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.
ve.legalDoc.terms.estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
ve.legalDoc.terms.estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.
ve.legalDoc.terms.liability.title: Your decisions
ve.legalDoc.terms.liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.
ve.legalDoc.terms.accounts.title: Accounts
ve.legalDoc.terms.accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.
ve.legalDoc.terms.ending.title: Ending the pilot
ve.legalDoc.terms.ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.
ve.legalDoc.terms.complaints.title: Complaints
ve.legalDoc.terms.complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

ve.landing.faq.title: Before you try it
ve.landing.faq.bank.a: No. Tengo is a pilot app that estimates how long your money lasts. It does not hold money, lend, sell products or give financial advice.
ve.landing.faq.data.a: As a guest, your data stays in this browser on your device and nothing is sent to Tengo. Anyone who uses this browser can open it, so use the PIN lock on a shared phone. An account is optional; it stores your data with the database provider named in the privacy notice.
ve.landing.faq.cost.a: Nothing. Tengo is free to use during the pilot, with no sign up needed.
ve.landing.faq.wrong.q: What if the date is wrong?
ve.landing.faq.wrong.a: It is an estimate from your own history, so it can be wrong. Open Why this date to see what went in, correct any transaction on Money, or use Question this result to ask for a check. In this demo that request is simulated and stays on your device.
